title: Main page layout
question: Kiln stays the look, spectators finding the event come first, and organizers get a New tournament button. Pick how the tournament list lays out, steer one, or re-roll. (Names below are sample content.)

options.label: Trophy shelf
options.lineage: the club's trophy cabinet by the door, with this weekend's event pinned on the noticeboard above it
options.thesis: What's being played leads as wide notice rows; finished tournaments sit below as a shelf of champion plaques, each naming its winner in amber.
materials: wide live rows with stage chips
options.viewport: Ink band reading 'Tournaments', with the ember 'New tournament' button on the right when signed in (it opens the name field under the band). Then 'Playing now': each tournament in pool play or playoffs as a wide row, name in Unbounded, stage chip, team count and date, the whole row a link. 'Coming up' lists drafts as quieter rows. Then 'Champions': finished tournaments as a grid of plaques, the champion's name large in amber, the tournament and date beneath.
options.risk: A finished tournament with no bracket winner needs a plain plaque, and the shelf grows long over many seasons.

regions.label: Coming up: Fall Open · Draft · 6 teams

options.label: By date
options.lineage: the fixtures board at a club: today's events first, then the season behind them
options.thesis: Tournaments grouped by when they were made: Today leads with its events large, then This week, then Earlier, each row with stage, teams and, once finished, the champion.
options.viewport: Ink band with the 'New tournament' button. A 'Today' heading with today's tournaments as large rows: name, stage chip, team count and a Courts link. 'This week' and 'Earlier' follow as compact rows: name, stage, teams, date, and the champion in amber where finished.
options.risk: Groups use the date a tournament was created, not the day it's played, so one set up the night before shows under 'This week' on the day.

regions.label: Spring Classic · Pool play · 12 teams · Courts
Summer Cup · Complete · Champion: Ice Wolves

options.label: Tournament table
options.lineage: the league table in a local paper's sports page
options.thesis: One table of every tournament, Name, Stage, Teams, Created, Champion, with what's being played sorted first; on a phone each row folds into a two-line card.
options.viewport: Ink band with the 'New tournament' button. A panel holding one table: tournaments in play first, with their stage chip lit, then drafts, then finished ones with the champion in amber. Each row links to its tournament; column heads sort.
options.risk: Even-handed and dense: the live event leads the table but stands out only by its chip, and on phones the columns fold into stacked rows.
